name: @antpath/repository
description: Repository for the antpath SDK, CLI, contracts, conformance helpers, user tests, and docs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @antpath/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @antpath/conformance run build && pnpm --filter @antpath/cli run build && pnpm --filter antpath run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @antpath/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @antpath/conformance run build && pnpm --filter antpath run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 --if-present run lint && pnpm run lint:tests
scripts.test:unit: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 --if-present run test:unit && pnpm exec vitest run --root scripts/validate capability-matrix.test.ts
scripts.pack:sdk: pnpm --filter antpath run publish:dry-run && pnpm run contracts:boundary:check
